**Alright guildies, lets all pool our info and share to help out new members. As well as regulars.**

-Guild signup day is on SUNDAY. Make sure your defense is set by Saturday night so we can put you on the roster.

-Once defense players are set for the week they cannot be changed and the number of attackers must equal the number of defenders in order to battle. If we are short from just one member leaving, we must recruit one in order to continue for the week.

-To set a guild defense tap community> guild battle>defense. Alternately, if a battle is in progress you can tap the red shield on the left hand side of the screen, or tap Elia and select “guild battle” and then tap defense. NOTE: you must select “COMPLETE” to set it, not set them and then click the x. (believe it or not that’s happened to a former member lol)

-The screen does swipe left and right during battle. Seems obvious but I’ve had to explain that to a couple people so I’m just putting it out there.

-At least 10 members must have a defense set by Sunday, in order for our guild to enter for battles.

-You can continue to attack after we have won a battle. Further, you can attack defeated guild members if we have won the battle.

-Leader skills can be a huge help in guild battles.

NOTE: be sure to check that the leader skill you are using works in the area you are playing in. Look at the upper right hand corner of the leader skill.

A=arena

D=dungeons

G= Guild Battle

Element symbol= works everywhere for that element

If there is no letter or symbol in the upper right corner of the leader skill, it works everywhere.

-Attacking a member with full health will do 30% damage to a singular opponent's MAX HP

-Damage done to an opponents HP is decreased by 5% with each attack until you reach 10%. So the first attack does 30%(1st round) and 25% (2nd round) if the opponent has full health.

-It takes 3 people to attack and win both rounds to destroy a singular opponent. 1st takes 55% 2nd takes 35% 3rd takes 10% (if not correct me on this)

-For each individual Victory during battle, a proportionate amount of HP will be deducted from the HP of the opposing guild.

-For each Draw during battle, 5% of the opposing guilds HP will be deducted.

I'm bad with percentages please comment if you think I did that wrong...

-Some opponents have +1, +2, or +3. Those opponents give additional points and may be harder to beat. The members on the battlefield are arranged according to their score from last weeks arena tally. Highest score on the left and the lowest on the right.

Also if we only have members that attack both day and night it makes things a lot easier on the leads, as far as rotation goes and keeping track of who is attacking.
